arabic text: SHAAM WAALO, BETIYAN HAI, YE NABI KI NA SATAAO
english translation text: O PEOPLE OF SHAAM, THESE ARE THE DAUGHTERS OF PROPHET, DO NOT HURT THEM

arabic text: SHAAM WAALO, BETIYAN HAI, YE NABI KI NA SATAAO\nHAR GALI SHAHZADIYO KO AY SITAMGHAR NA PHIRAWO
english translation text: O PEOPLE OF SHAAM, THESE ARE THE DAUGHTERS OF PROPHET, DO NOT HURT THEM,\nO OPPRESSOR, DO NOT MAKE THEM PASS THROUGH ALL THESE STREETS

arabic text: QUL KAFAA KE, HAL ATAA KE, HAI YE WAARIS INNAMA KE\nDAR BA DAR INKO RULA KAR MUJHKO NA KHOON RULAWO
english translation text: THESE LADIES ARE INHERITORS OF THE WILAYAH,\nDO NOT MAKE THEM CRY BY TAKING THEM HERE AND THERE LIKE CATTLE, DO NOT MAKE ME CRY TEARS OF BLOOD

arabic text: CHALTE CHALTE DHAL CHUKI HAI, RAAT GALIYON MEIN HAMARI,\nTHAK GAYE HAI QAIDI BACHE BE GUNAHO KO BAHAWO
english translation text: THEY HAVE BEEN WALKING DAY AND NIGHT,,\nTHE INNOCENT CHILD WHO HAS BEEN TAKEN CAPTIVE IS TIRED NOW

arabic text: DENGE HUM TUMKO DUWAAE, DE DO KUCH DHER RIDAAYEN\nGAR NAHI DETE RIDAAYEN TO CHIRAAGHON KO BHUJAAWO
english translation text: PLEASE GIVE US BACK OUR VEILS, WE WILL PRAY FOR YOU,\nIF YOU ARE NOT GIVING THEM BACK THEN AT LEAST TURN OUT THE LANTERNS

arabic text: KHAAK PAR NEEND NAHI AATI, YE TO ISMAT KI PALI HAI\nSAR BAREHNA HAI NA DEKHO APNI NAZRO KO JHUKAWO
english translation text: WE ARE UNABLE TO SLEEP ON THE DUSTY GROUND, WE ARE FROM\nTHE PURE HOUSEHOLD, THE LADIES ARE WITHOUT THEIR VEIL, PLEASE LOWER YOUR GAZE

arabic text: DEKHLO AALE NABHI HAI, HUM TO AWLAADE ALI HAI\nKIS NE KYA JURM KIYA HAI HUM KO ITNA TO BATAADO
english translation text: REMEMBER WE ARE THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET (PBUH) AND CHILDREN OF ALI (A.S.),\nAT LEAST TELL US WHAT CRIME WE HAVE COMMITTED
